title: Pull the Prop Away
setup: Your rook on d1 attacks the bishop on d5, which is defended only by the knight on b4.
hint: Follow the defense backward. Which black piece holds d5, and what of yours can reach that piece?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxb4}} trades a bishop for the knight that guards d5. After {{axb4}} the bishop has no protection left and {{Rxd5}} takes it. The first capture is even; the second one is free. Work backward from the target to the piece that keeps it alive.
